features.title: Optimization Opportunity Identification
features.description: Implement a system to identify potential optimization opportunities in pipeline execution.
acceptance_criteria: The system highlights areas with performance bottlenecks.
Users receive suggestions for potential optimizations.
The system provides historical comparisons to track improvements.

features.title: Performance Visualization Dashboard
features.description: Create a dashboard to visualize pipeline performance trends.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays key performance metrics in real-time.
Users can filter data by time range and pipeline stage.
Visualizations include graphs and charts for trend analysis.

features.title: Data Analysis Module
features.description: Develop a module to analyze pipeline execution metrics.
acceptance_criteria: The module can ingest raw execution data.
The module processes data to extract key metrics.
The module outputs data in a structured format for further use.
